note: Two shaded grass back-in sites in the small state forest campground at the old Masten CCC camp, with a latrine within 300 ft and a picnic table at each. The agency says the sites were not designed for RVs and its campsite map layer calls them tent or small trailer/RV sites; the pads are listed as 27 by 19 ft and 29 by 23 ft, with 20 ft of overhead clearance. It also warns that map apps and GPS units misread the roads here: come from PA 14 by Masten Road (formerly Pleasant Stream Road), from Ellenton Mountain Road by Masten Road, or from Hoppestown Road by Cabbage Hollow, Cascade and Mill Creek Roads. A temporary above-ground waterline being installed in the area may bring periods of increased activity, expected at least through summer 2027. Unlike the rest of this forest's campsites, these are not rested for half the year. Pack out trash. --Claude
